tools.name: JotForm
tools.desc: Create custom forms and surveys easily online
pros: Ready to use out of the box, no local install or maintenance
Free tier available, try before you upgrade
cons: Advanced features and higher limits usually require a paid plan
usage:
Step: Open the official site and sign up
Click the red "Visit official site" button to open the JotForm homepage. Find "Sign Up" and log in with email or Google/GitHub.
Tip:
If the site won’t load, check your connection or try another browser.

Step: Pick the plan that fits you
New users usually get a free trial or free quota. Start with the Free tier before upgrading.
Check:
After sign-up you should see the Dashboard home.

Step: Create your first task / project
Click "New" or "Create New" and follow the guide. Pick the first template to start.
Tip:
Don’t start with a complex request. Test with one simple sentence, e.g. "Summarize this page into 3 points".

Step: Review and save the result
When done, the tool shows the result. Export, copy the link, or save locally.
Check:
If unhappy, click "Regenerate" or tweak the prompt and try again.
tools.detail: JotForm is an online form builder that empowers users to create custom forms and surveys with ease. With a user-friendly interface and a wide range of templates, JotForm is suitable for both beginners and advanced users. Key features include drag-and-drop form building, integration with popular services like Google Drive, Dropbox, and payment gateways, and real-time analytics. It is ideal for businesses, educators, and individuals who need to collect information efficiently. Pros include its versatility, ease of use, and extensive customization options. However, limitations may include a learning curve for some users and potential costs for advanced features.
